links.outcome: LLM accuracy across question formats and reasoning levels on a dental benchmark
links.effect: Accuracy fell from 81.34% on multiple-choice to 64.53% on short-answer and 22.34% on case-based questions; from 74.01% at L1 to 55.64% at L2 and 35.71% at L3.
links.quote: Specifically, accuracy plummeted from 81.34% on multiple-choice to 64.53% on short-answer and 22.34% on case-based questions, while declining markedly from 74.01% at L1 to 55.64% at L2 and 35.71% at L3.

links.outcome: Safety of LLM-generated clinical recommendations in real-world dental cases
links.effect: Overall unsafe rate of 31.01% in LLM-generated clinical recommendations, with 4.51% posing risks of irreversible patient harm, particularly in orthodontics.
links.quote: More critically, risk analysis of real-world dental cases demonstrated an alarming overall unsafe rate of 31.01% in LLM-generated clinical recommendations, with 4.51% posing risks of irreversible patient harm and risks particularly pronounced in specialties such as orthodontics.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates frontier LLMs on a multinational benchmark (GlobalDentBench) across clinical dental reasoning and risk/safety, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
